prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: low-speed head-on collision in Pasadena, Texas. Injury: wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1319; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving my own car, which is insured under my policy, when the accident happened in Pasadena, Texas. Traffic was moving slowly, and I was going at low speed when the front of my vehicle met the front of the car ahead of me. Neither of us was going fast enough for airbags to deploy, but the impact threw my left arm against the steering wheel. At the emergency room I was told I had a fractured wrist, and I have been wearing a cast since. I have described the events the same way to the adjuster, to the officer at the scene, and to the doctor who treated me, and I have nothing to add or change to that account. I am providing this statement so the claim can be processed, and I am happy to supply medical records or photos if they would help.
